verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party pinned-version, lockfile, or update-channel control for Superpowers skills. Updates are described only as 'reinstall with the same command'. The working `npx skills add ... --copy` install that vendors skill files into a project dir uses a third-party installer. Committing the vendored files would be a user-side workaround, not a Superpowers versioning feature.
